asked.item: Can AI write a caption for my dog photo

verdict.reason: The FAQ explains how to get an AI-generated caption for a photo.

steps.text: You can't upload a photo as Context, because Context is for text-based content.
Go to the AI Agent and add text Context describing what the photo is about.
Type your request in the chat box at the bottom of the screen to generate a draft post from your text.
Click Photo / Video on the post to attach your photo, then edit the caption with Chat as needed.
